summary: Project kickoff. Priorities: reconstruction accuracy > speed; privacy guard. Engines: PySpark + Rust binary (Polars/DataFusion). Harness-owned reference sampler. polly triages and dispositions against frozen policy; human merges. PRs target feat/profiler-rsi on ghanse/dbldatagen.
Rust engine deferred by human decision; Phase 1 is PySpark-only. Profile spec stays engine-neutral so a Rust (Polars/DataFusion) binary can be added later.

Merge policy (human decision): polly merges PRs that pass cross-vendor review (and, for RSI proposals, the benchmark gate) into feat/profiler-rsi on ghanse/dbldatagen. Upstream is never touched; the human reviews the branch and log before upstreaming.

P1.7 RSI log tooling merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/4 (head 2101e13). Cross-review (cursor): 0 blocking after 1 fix round. Post-merge defect found by polly: append --kind flag is dropped (stdin JSON path works); fix task P1.7a opened.
P1.7a merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/5 (head 8b04e7f). Root cause: _load_values iterated kind names instead of the kind field. Cross-review (cursor): 0 blocking.

P1.1 package scaffold + profile spec v0.1.0 merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/6 (head 9fe795d). Cross-review (codex): 4 rounds. Resolved: forward-compatible schema (unknown fields tolerated, strict opt-in), major version encoded in schema, lossless string encoding for decimal/int64, privacy block with min-frequency k (default 10) enforced on top_values/enumerations/patterns incl. nested value_count, extrema suppression covering quantiles/histogram edges, expression constraints opt-in. Literals embedded in regexes are delegated to the benchmark privacy guard (P1.5).

P1.2 baseline PySpark engine merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/7 (head dd28372). Cross-review (cursor): 3 rounds; fixed timestamp extremes shifted by host TZ, non-finite float extremes, CLI UTC/error handling, source metadata without paths. polly found the engine permanently mutated the caller's session timeZone; fixed with scoped set/restore. Also refactored rsi_log.py (behavior-preserving) for PLR0912. Accepted debt: one Spark job per nested child (logged as speed candidate).

P1.2a merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/11 (head f622620). Baseline engine computed avg/stddev of decimal(38,x) in decimal and overflowed under ANSI at tier s (found by P1.5). Now cast to double for mean/stddev; min/max stay exact. Cross-review (cursor): 0 blocking; test ANSI-flag leak fixed before merge.

P1.3 dataset catalog + profiler-bench package merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/8 (head 430568b). 6 datasets / 11 tables / 288 columns, tiers xs/s/m, ground-truth manifests verified against data. Cross-review (codex): 3 rounds. Resolved: distribution-family GOF (KS / fixed-bin chi-square, alpha 1e-5), measure-specific dependency SEs, canonical little-endian logical hash covering manifest, cache verification on load, privacy taxonomy + planted quasi-identifier set, non-sequential keys + shuffled multi-file tiers, structure_seed/sample_seed split (enables real-vs-real ceiling at fixed structure). Deferred: real public datasets (P1.3b).

P1.4 reference sampler merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/9 (head 2bd710b, rebased onto 6dcbfe2 with sampler code byte-identical to approved e7dd210). Implements full spec 0.1.0 with a SampleReport of used/ignored/unmet fields per column. Cross-review (cursor): 2 rounds; 7 blockers fixed with regressions (exact decimal arithmetic, histogram/copula OOB, FK coverage over non-nulls, expression determinism, copula-preserving cardinality pools, strict comparisons, pipeline order constraints->FK->keys with audit). polly required test expansion 6 -> 56 cases, which exposed 6 further bugs. Scope: scales to tier s only. Known approximations: Cramer's V, correlation_ratio ignored, TimeType as ISO strings, interval/variant defaults.

P1.6 RSI runner + evaluator merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/12 (head 6620c86). Fresh-process driver timing (wall/CPU/peak RSS; JVM RSS not measured), rotating A/B order, paired sampler seeds, candidate imported from its own worktree (tested), build + harness identity hashes, default policy (accuracy gate +0.005 of ceiling with CI lb>0, per-dataset regression <0.01, structure <0.02; speed gate >=5% CI-supported, bounds 10% wall/CPU, max(5%,64MiB) RSS; privacy hard guard). Cross-review (codex): 3 rounds; fixed expected-matrix completeness incl. duplicates/unexpected/raw failures, non-disableable privacy guard, stratified per-dataset bootstrap, control/identical builds never accepted, RSS bound, harness identity. Real Scorer wiring pending P1.5.

Correction to seq 11: it was appended after a 'gh pr merge 12' call that returned HTTP 502, before the merge was confirmed; PR #12 was still OPEN at that time. Merge retried and confirmed: merge commit b84a16e. Process fix: polly now verifies PR state == MERGED before logging a merge.
